description: Turned both locks, and would not copy a joke twice.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Named the eightpence at the door.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Paid the eightpence and told the yard not to be looked at.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked the breadth, and did not look back.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Asked after a loft, and was told the stage was dark.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Answered Nick without a measurement, and left the nine lines uncut.
name: William Shakespeare
